items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: like Ben Webster and all this...

ctx.x: But it seemed Bird would come up out of left field with some tune in the middle of another tune.

Yeah. Well, Bird had a very melodic way of putting things, you know. The way he played his horn, the way he would play a song, he had his own of doing it that nobody else was playing like that. When I first heard him, he sounded so different, I had never heard nobody play like that, and I had worked...you know, I came to work with Hawk and all of the other big names that was out here, like Ben Webster and all this... But Bird, pshew, I don't know where he come from, all of a sudden, out of nowhere. Like the song…
Do you think he influenced the whole...
